description: Provably fair random draws for giveaways, raffles, games and A/B assignment. Pick winners from a list (unique or with replacement, optional weights), shuffle a list, split people into balanced teams, draw integers in a range, or roll dice ("3d6+2", "4d6kh3"). Randomness is HMAC-SHA256(serverSeed, clientSeed:nonce:counter) with unbiased rejection sampling and Fisher–Yates; the response publishes the server seed, its SHA-256 commitment and the algorithm so anyone can re-run and verify the draw. Supply serverSeed + clientSeed to reproduce a previous draw exactly. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/random-draw

clientSeed.description: Your seed (e.g. a public value fixed before the draw)

dice.description: Dice notation: NdS(+/-M), kh/kl to keep highest / lowest, e.g. "4d6kh3", "2d20kl1", "3d6+2"

items.description: Entries (strings / numbers / objects) for pick, shuffle, teams; max 10,000

serverSeed.description: Verification: re-run a draw with its published server seed (hex)

weights.description: pick: non-negative weight per item (with unique=true, weighted sampling without replacement)

name: random_draw
title: Random Draw
